scope: Corollary 2.4 of the manuscript “Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints” (preprints/Minimal-metrics-and-interior-injectivity-for-nef-adjoints-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b2a7d738f44a3d34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, let ϕ be a minimal weight on the actual rational line bundle N. Then I(tϕ) = OV for every real t > 0, where the ideal is defined by local integrability of |f|2e−tϕ. The conclusion is independent of the choice of minimal metric and of the Cartier multiple used to normalize its weights.
